description: Datadog monitors for the Spaced Repetition System (SRS). All monitors target Prometheus-style metrics exposed by the NestJS backend via OpenMetrics and ingested by the Datadog Agent.

monitors.name: [SRS] High number of due cards
[SRS] Low average easiness factor
[SRS] Low review success rate
[SRS] Cards stuck at level 0
[SRS] Review activity dropped to zero
monitors.message:
{{#is_alert}}
No SRS review events have been recorded in the last 30 minutes. This could indicate a complete outage of the review pipeline or zero user engagement.

**Actions:**
1. Check the flashcards API health endpoint.
2. Verify the NestJS backend is running and the Supabase connection is healthy.
3. Check for deployment or infrastructure incidents.
{{/is_alert}}

monitors.name: [SRS] Review latency spike
monitors.message:
{{#is_alert}}
The average SRS review duration (successful reviews) has exceeded 5 seconds over the last 10 minutes. The SM-2 calculation is CPU-trivial, so any latency spike points to Supabase query slowdown or network issues.

**Current value:** {{value}}s
**Threshold:** 5s

**Actions:**
1. Check Supabase / PostgreSQL query performance.
2. Inspect the flashcards table for missing indexes.
3. Check for rate limiting or connection pool exhaustion.
{{/is_alert}}
